name: Texas UIL State Cross Country Championships
where: Round Rock, TX · Old Settlers Park
headline: Texas state: No. 3 Southlake Carroll and No. 6 El Paso Eastwood
summary: Two top-10 boys teams in DyeStat’s national rankings race for state titles at Old Settlers Park: No. 3 Southlake Carroll and No. 6 El Paso Eastwood. Southlake Carroll’s Kai Gutierrez (No. 5) and El Paso Eastwood’s Noah Garcia (No. 7) are among the top individuals in the country. All six classes race over two days, with the first race at 8:15 a.m. CT both days.
